key_insight: KnowSR combines multimodal patient data with structured disease knowledge to better distinguish neurodegenerative disorders with overlapping features.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support differential diagnosis when imaging and clinical observations overlap or are incomplete, but clinical utility remains unestablished.
method: Aligns patient representations with literature-grounded disease prototypes and evidence directions.
Uses target-aware pooling to incorporate disease-specific evidence.
Reconciles pairwise diagnostic comparisons over a sparse graph of competing diagnoses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains over 19 baselines for patient-level six-class diagnosis using patient-disjoint five-fold evaluation, without numerical results or dataset sizes.
watch_item: External validation is not described in the abstract, leaving generalizability to other clinical settings uncertain.
paper_title: Neurodegenerative Differential Diagnosis with Knowledge-enhanced Structural Reasoning
